name: Susy Linnet
source:
The youngest of the inseparable trio, Susy is a bubbly, if somewhat impressionable, young woman working at Dress Me Down clothing. Susy loves fashion and fancy things, and the quickest way to her heart is showing her that money is no issue.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
